summary: The filing is a Form 6-K reporting routine director/PDMR shareholdings under the EU/UK Market Abuse Regulation. It discloses acquisitions of ordinary shares by the Chief Technology Officer and Chief HR Officer on the Amsterdam and London exchanges at prices around EUR 14.44–14.66 and GBP 12.50–12.58. No corporate event, tender offer, or strategic review is involved. This is a standard insider-trade notification with no special-situation structure or deal terms.
